public_rationale: In August 2023, replying to Dario Amodei's projection of AGI in 2-3 years and to similar projections by Demis Hassabis, Marcus wrote 'I seriously doubt it', citing many serious unsolved problems in generative AI. A strong doubt is recorded and not scored.
limitations: This record does not assess whether AGI arrived by August 2026. The post describes AGI broadly, as general purpose AI 'as smart and resourceful as humans if not more so', but gives no test for it.
